shared_elements: horizontal band of repeating ornament (zigzag / rosettes)
row of animals aligned along a baseline
justification: Both are shallow stone reliefs organised into horizontal registers, in which profile quadrupeds and an upright human figure stand on a baseline directly above a continuous band of repeating ornament — a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The manner of cutting is quite unlike, however: A is blocky, schematic and abstracted with figures floating at varied scales and orientations on a tall narrow pillar, whereas B is smoothly modelled, anatomically observed and confined to a single tidy processional frieze with neat rosette borders.
